candidates.change_summary: Replace the increment with a precondition that disallows overflow by reverting if depositsCount would not strictly increase, then increment.
Remove the require check so depositsCount increments unconditionally.
Add a revert after the require so receive always reverts and depositsCount does not change.
Change the increment to decrement so depositsCount decreases on each receive.
Replace the safe arithmetic-style check with an explicit overflow check using unchecked block and then increment within unchecked (changes behavior on overflow in 0.8).
Replace the call to withdraw(address(this).balance) with a direct transfer of the contract balance to msg.sender, which changes gas/behavior and can alter final state visible after withdrawAll.
Change the onlyOwner modifier to require msg.sender != owner (inverting the check), which will prevent owner from withdrawing and thus change observable withdrawAll behavior.
Replace transfer with call and ignore return (uses .call{value: _value}("") to send funds instead of transfer), which can change reentrancy and gas behavior and thus observable withdraw outcome.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from withdraw so anyone can call it, changing who can withdraw and thus the observable balance after withdraw.
Invert the onlyOwner require to forbid the owner and allow others, changing who can call withdraw and thus observable outcome.
